The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This role requires fluency in both German and English.

The Role:  

As an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Duties are performed across one or more assigned client accounts, which will vary over time.

Top 5 Responsibilities:  

  • Account & Client Communication  
    Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels.  
  • Reporting & Data Management  
    Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance.  
  • Strategy Execution & Task Ownership  
    Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals.  
  • Program & Portfolio Management  
    Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions.  
  • Team Collaboration & Growth  
    Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights.  

What Success Looks Like:  

By 6 Months:  

  • You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment.  
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance.  
  • You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance.  

By 1 Year:  

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.  
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.  
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.  

 

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate  

  • Strong sense of curiosity  
  • Critical thinker  
  • Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable  
  • Flexible, resilient, coachable  
  • Relationship and service oriented  
  • Proactive and outcome oriented  
  • Strong work ethic and personal standards  

 

Qualifications & Skills:  

  • Fluency in German
  • 1-2 years of experience- background in online marketing, e-commerce, or affiliate marketing beneficial.  
  • Familiarity with affiliate networks and SaaS platforms (e.g., ShareASale, Commission Junction, Impact) is a plus.  
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, formatting, etc.).  
  • Knowledge of HTML is a plus.  
  • Ability to travel when necessary for conferences and team meetings.  

 

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?  

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing.  

AP Perks & Benefits - What we offer  

  • 100% remote work for everyone  
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off  
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December  
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off  
  • Focus Fridays (no internal meetings)  
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits  
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowance  
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!  
  • Target salary range: £27–37K depending on location and experience  

 

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.  

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

description: Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Aufträge, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Die Rolle Du übernimmst ein eigenes Book von rund 70 bis 90 Generalunternehmern, Bauträgern und Planern und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Consulting-Team eine erfolgreiche Aktivierung sicher. Du sicherst die Verlängerung, baust Nutzung und Vertrag aus und merkst früh, wenn ein Kunde abrutscht. Wo ein Kunde noch nicht richtig angekommen ist, holst du ihn gemeinsam mit dem Consulting-Team in die Nutzung. Verlängerungen, Upgrades und Cross-Sell verhandelst du selbst, mit Geschäftsführung, Einkauf und Kalkulation. Jede Vertragsfrist der nächsten zwölf Monate hast du im Blick, ab 120 Tagen davor läuft dein Renewal-Ablauf, und deinen Forecast pflegst du jede Woche. Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles. Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades. Die Kündigungen in deinem Book liegen unter deinem Ziel, und jede Frist der nächsten zwölf Monate hat eine Renewal-Opportunity mit Forecast-Kategorie. Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss. Warnsignale in deinem Book, etwa sinkende Nutzung oder ein weggefallener Key User, haben schnell einen Plan. Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast. Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast. Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal. Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger. Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird. Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn du ein Book mit vielen Kunden lieber selbst steuerst, als fünf Großkunden zu betreuen. du Verlängerungen verhandelst und dabei den Preis hältst, statt Rabatt zu geben. du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast. du deine Zahlen kennst und sie dich motivieren. du mit Geschäftsführern im Mittelstand auf Augenhöhe sprichst und verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft wird. Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest. du aus Support, Service oder reinem Onboarding kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest. du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und 70 Kunden als zu viel empfindest. du lieber über Transformation präsentierst, als einen Vertrag zu verlängern. Harte Anforderungen Rund 2 bis 3 Jahre im Account Management, Customer Success oder Sales im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit eigener Verantwortung für Bestandskunden und Umsatz. Belegbare Ergebnisse bei Verlängerungen, Upsell oder Kündigungen in den letzten Perioden. Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch und Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS sind ein Plus. Für Key Account Manager zusätzlich: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Unternehmensgruppen oder Konzernkunden, mehreren Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles. Vergütung 70-110k OTE - inkl. Ungedeckeltem Bonus mit transparenter Provisionsregelung; die Höhe richtet sich nach dem Level. Was wir bieten Klarheit: Ein eigenes Book, klare Ziele, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis. Rückhalt: Ein eigenes Consulting-Team übernimmt das Onboarding, du konzentrierst dich aufs Halten und Ausbauen. Entwicklung: Vom Account Manager zum Key Account Manager oder Team Lead, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s, Entwicklungsgesprächen und offener Feedbackkultur. Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung. Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt. Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline. description:
Qui sommes-nous?

Artefact est une société de conseil et d'ingénierie française spécialisée en data et IA, et leader en Europe, qui depuis plus de 10 ans est spécialisée dans la conception et le déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de solutions data-driven. Basé à Paris, nous sommes aujourd’hui présents dans 27 pays sur tous les continents et comptons 2500 collaborateurs. 

Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux.

La performance de nos services data repose sur une réelle expertise technologique en Intelligence Artificielle et des compétences métiers acquises auprès de nos 1000+ clients dans le monde, tels que Ubisoft, Sisley, OVH, Thales, Edenred, GRDF, EMG…  La force d'Artefact repose sur un mix unique d'atouts: des technologies data de pointe, des méthodes agiles permettant de délivrer très rapidement les projets et des équipes composées des meilleurs experts dans leurs domaines (consultants data, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, et des experts du digital marketing sur tous les canaux).

Dans ce contexte, notre practice Digital Marketing recherche pour accompagner sa croissance un(e) Consultant(e) Senior SEO/GEO.

Au sein de l’équipe AI Search, qui déploie des stratégies intégrées organiques (SEO/GEO) et payantes (SEA/GEA) pour ses clients — le/la Consultant(e) Senior SEO/GEO aura pour missions :

  • Délivrer des projets SEO/GEO sous la supervision des directeurs AI Search et des consultants digital marketing
  • Assurer l’interface avec le(s) partenaire(s) outil pour l’extraction des données
  • Produire des documents d’analyse: insights, benchmarks, recommandations et plan d’actions prioriser
  • Suivre la bonne mise en oeuvre des recommandations
     

Profil recherché:

  • Formation Bac +4/5, avec au minimum 3 ans d’expérience en SEO en agence spécialisée
  • Des bases en GEO sont un plus pour la candidature, mais non obligatoires
  • Rigueur et maîtrise des KPI’s et du Web Analytics
  • Anglais courant

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

  • Artefact est the place to be: venez construire l'avenir du data marketing et de l’AI Search
  • Progression: chaque nouvelle mission offre de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités d'apprendre
  • Culture: rejoignez une des meilleures équipes européennes en data marketing
  • Entreprenariat : vous rejoindrez une équipe d'entrepreneurs motivés dont l’objectif est la croissance continue et pérenne de l’entreprise

 Process de recrutement : 

  1. HR call : Talent Acquisition Specialist  
  2. Entretien avec un Directeur AI Search et une consultante senior SEO (1h en présentiel + 1 étude de cas qui sera effectuée en direct)
  3. Entretien avec un Digital & Data marketing Partner (45 min en présentiel)

Rémunération

Fourchette de rémunération prévue : 40k€ à 46k€ brut/ annuel selon profil 

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

description: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank. We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position Work from anywhere! Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless. You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay. Build one Customer organisation, not four. Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call. You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations. How you'll operate This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger. You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. What you'll have done 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime). Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either. Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC. Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app. Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage. Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite. A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove. The first 90 days Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board. Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads. Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week. What this role is not Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions. Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed. Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed. Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached. Other requirements A dedicated workspace. A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. Why work for Xapo? Impact Globally, Work Remotely. Shape the Future Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world. Great work-life balance Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. Expect Excellence Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals. At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders. description:
About Factor

Factor is the #1 ready-to-eat brand for people who see personal health as a key ingredient to achieving their goals. Developed by chefs and dietitians, Factor makes healthy eating effortless, enjoyable, and full of flavor. Part of the HelloFresh Group, Factor is the fastest-growing business in the group, and we are now building the next chapter in Europe.

About the role

We are looking for a senior marketing leader to own Factor's European growth. You will run the full marketing agenda across multiple markets: acquiring new customers efficiently, owning the P&L across countries, and building the partnerships and channels that will take Factor beyond direct-to-consumer. This is a lean, flat team that moves fast. You will have full accountability for European decisions, and you will work directly with the leadership team to shape where the business goes next.

What you'll do

  • Scale new customer acquisition at efficient CAC. Own the social-first growth engine (Meta, influencers, and partnerships) and keep it efficient as spend grows significantly.
  • Own the P&L across multiple markets. Set and deliver marketing plans, targets, and budgets, and make the trade-offs between markets and channels.
  • Grow the partnerships network. Expand our rolodex of influencers and strategic partners that feed the acquisition engine.
  • Lead creative with a clear point of view. Oversee creative functions and set a direction for how Factor shows up for customers.
  • Partner with finance. Work with finance on business planning, forecasting, and end-to-end customer retention.
  • Prepare new growth channels. Build toward new distribution channels such as retail and B2B over the next 12 to 18 months, establishing revenue lines beyond direct-to-consumer.
  • Build and lead a lean, high-performing team. Create clear accountability and keep the organization flat, adding capacity only where the opportunity is clear.

What you'll bring

  • Senior marketing leadership at a scaled European subscription or e-commerce brand, with a track record of growing new customer volume at efficient acquisition costs.
  • P&L ownership across several countries. You have been accountable for results, not only for marketing activity.
  • General management experience. This can come from business, strategy, or consulting roles, or from end-to-end management, including at a smaller company.
  • Multi-market exposure. You have led or covered several markets as part of your scope.
  • Hands-on leadership. You are comfortable diving deep yourself and are not only a manager of managers. Earlier-stage or high-growth experience is a strong plus.
  • Data-driven judgment. You are fluent in data and use it to make fast, clear decisions.
  • Speed and agility, relentless prioritization, and a growth mindset. You thrive in fast-moving environments and focus on what moves the business.
  • Customer centricity. You put the customer at the center and work well across functions, including operations and finance.

What we offer

  • Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
  • Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA. 
  • You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop and phone.
  • Build your future with a pension plan through Aegon Cappital (age-based rates, 50/50 split).
  • Receive a 7,5% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis (2026), plus free access to Headspace and OpenUp.
  • Get discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, plus free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam).
  • Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup with a €2.45 daily remote work allowance.
  • Start with 24 days of annual leave (pro-rata), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
  • Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, and €0.23 per km for car/bicycle travel.
  • Participate internal/external opportunities aligned with our Job Framework, and join our cross-market mentoring program.
  • Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€20/month), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Le rôle En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux. Tes responsabilités Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet. Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux. Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée. Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.). Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation. Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux. Ce que tu vas faire concrètement 1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME) Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients. Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement. Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives. 2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration. Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution. 3) Satisfaction & rétention Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur. Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires. Indicateurs de réussite CSAT sur ton portefeuille. Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL. Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux. Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention. Profil recherché Expérience de 5 ans minimum : en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale) Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur. Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre. Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc. Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser. Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- . Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement." Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

JDC Warehouse Specialist
Position Overview
The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.
The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.
Key Responsibilities
1. Receiving & Dispatch
•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.
•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.
•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.
•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.
2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations
•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.
•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.
•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.
3. Inventory & Asset Control
•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.
•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.
•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.
•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.
4. Security, Safety & Compliance
•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.
•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.
•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).
5. Process & Continuous Improvement
•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.
•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.
•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.
6. Local Expertise
•    Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.
•    Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.
7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)
•    + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.
•    + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.
Expectations
Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.
Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.
Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.
Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.
Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.

description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role 

As a Data Engineer within Engelhart's Finance department, you will build and operate reliable data pipelines connecting the data warehouse and CTRM platform with brokers and Futures Commission Merchants (FCMs), margin and collateral processes, and the wider Finance technology stack. You will help automate manual Finance workflows into tested, monitored jobs, with robust reconciliations and controls that give stakeholders confidence in the completeness and accuracy of financial data. 

This will be a full-time role based in our London office and owning the following responsibilities: 

  • Build, operate and maintain data pipelines between the data warehouse, CTRM platform, brokers and FCMs, margin and collateral processes, and Finance systems. 
  • Integrate data from the Finance stack, including P&L and F+, SAP General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, and bank statements. 
  • Automate manual Finance processes by developing reliable, tested and monitored jobs that can be operated and supported effectively. 
  • Implement reconciliations and data controls to identify missing or incomplete records, duplicates and breaks, and produce clear exception and break reporting. 
  • Ingest and process external files and feeds, including data received over SFTP and in formats such as CSV and XML. 
  • Investigate data and reconciliation issues, trace discrepancies through source systems and pipelines, and explain P&L or cash breaks to relevant Finance stakeholders. 
  • Develop and maintain serverless ETL solutions on AWS, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices to support consistent, controlled releases. 
  • Apply strong SQL and Python-based data processing to transform, validate and reconcile data accurately and efficiently. 
  • Work with Finance and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, improve existing workflows and deliver maintainable solutions with appropriate controls. 
  • Contribute to improving the reliability, observability and quality of Finance data flows as the business and its systems evolve. 

 

About You 

You will be a practical, analytical data engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with an understanding of Finance processes and controls. You can work with varied data sources, investigate discrepancies and explain the cause of a P&L or cash break clearly. You take ownership of the reliability of the jobs you build and look for opportunities to simplify and automate manual processes. 

As a result, we believe the following experiences and skills are essential for application: 

  • Strong Python development skills, including experience with Pandas and/or Polars, NumPy, and automated testing with pytest. 
  • Hands-on experience building AWS serverless ETL pipelines, using services such as Lambda, EventBridge, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB, CloudWatch and S3. 
  • Experience with AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Experience building APIs using Python frameworks, preferably FastAPI. 
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query, transform, validate and reconcile data. 
  • Experience ingesting external files and data feeds, including SFTP transfers and formats such as CSV and XML. 
  • Good understanding of Finance processes and data, with the analytical skills to investigate and clearly explain a P&L or cash break. 
  • A disciplined approach to testing, monitoring, reconciliation and control design, including checks for completeness, duplicates and exceptions. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to trace issues across systems and data pipelines. 
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Finance and technical stakeholders. 

The following experience is not required, but highly desirable for this role: 

  • Experience using Kafka from Python. 
  • Experience integrating with SAP or treasury systems. 
  • Exposure to trading data, including positions and P&L. 
  • Familiarity with dbt and/or Airflow. 

 

What we offer 

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.  
  • 25 days of annual holiday entitlement, excluding UK public holidays. 
  • Robust benefits package such as medical, dental, life insurance, generous pension contribution, and supplemental benefits partially subsidised by the Company.  
  • Eligibility to receive external and internal training in accordance with our Training & Development Policy. 

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest.

Your Mission

As Director Minerva Frontline, you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command & Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience.   • Own the end-to-end Minerva Frontline program, taking full accountability for its strategic roadmap, program budget, commercial targets, and cross-functional delivery across all three product lines.

  • Define and communicate a compelling product vision internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system.
  • Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline, pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw).
  • Drive seamless system interoperability, ensuring Minerva Frontline connects effortlessly with STARK’s physical unmanned platforms, third-party assets, and sovereign Battle Management Systems .
  • Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety.
  • Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO) over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment.
  • Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery.
  • Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites, ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces.
  • Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector, with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike.
  • Exceptional internal and external communication skills — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.
  • High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset, capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo.
  • Willingness to travel regularly between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe.

Nice-To-Have

  • Prior military service (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains.
  • Fluency in German, enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities.
  • An established network within the European defence ecosystem, military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community.
  • Experience with tactical Battle Management Systems (BMS), military simulation environments, or unmanned systems (UxV) operations.

description:
The Communications Tribe

The Communications Tribe is part of HelloFresh's Growth Alliance. Our mission is to enable a highly personalised, automated CRM communication ecosystem that prioritises user-centric engagement across our owned channels: email, push, SMS, in-app and embedded.

The problems we are solving:

  • How anyone with a good reason to speak to customers can do it safely and in minutes.
  • How we make sure every customer gets the right message, at the right moment, through the right channel, so that our communication is truly personal.
  • How we move to an autonomous, self-optimising system that continuously learns from every past interaction and gets better with each send.
  • How we make sure we can reach our customers in their preferred channels.

Our vision is to decentralise how HelloFresh talks to people across the whole relationship with us: prospects, subscribers and those who have left. Setting up and steering communications stops being the job of a small group of specialists and becomes something teams across the business can do safely, on top of tools and an intelligence layer that we build and that learn from every send. That loop reaches beyond CRM, so the customer experience is coherent from the first ad someone sees to the communication that converts and retains them.

As Director of Engineering, Communications, you will lead the engineering organisation that makes this real. You will set technical direction, hold the bar for reliability and operational excellence, and partner with Product, Marketing and CRM teams to turn the vision into working systems.

What you'll do

  • Lead the Communications engineering organisation through a layer of Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers, across Berlin and Warsaw.
  • Own the technical strategy for an autonomous, self-optimising communication system that learns from every interaction, and turn it into reality together with Product, Marketing and CRM teams.
  • Drive the move to true personalisation, so that every person we talk to gets the right message, at the right moment, through the right channel.
  • Build platforms that let teams across the business create and steer communications safely and on their own, inside clear guardrails.
  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of every system we run: SLOs, monitoring and alerting, incident management and on-call maturity, so that problems are caught before anyone downstream notices.
  • Expand our reach into new channels, from early experiments to scaled solutions, based on how people actually want to hear from us.
  • Lead our transformation into a GenAI-native engineering organisation, from AI-assisted development to agentic workflows embedded in everyday operations.
  • Manage, coach and develop Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers, holding them accountable for team health, delivery and engineering standards.
  • Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated as priorities evolve.

What you'll bring

  • Proven leadership at scale. 10+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years managing Engineering Managers or Leads. You have led teams across multiple offices and built trust without daily co-location.
  • Deep technical credibility. You can set direction for large-scale backend, data and event-driven systems, and you understand how applied machine learning and automated decisioning behave in production.
  • Platform thinking. A track record of building self-service platforms that enable non-engineers to work safely and quickly, including the governance and guardrails that make that possible.
  • AI-native leadership. You have built or scaled AI-native engineering practices and AI-driven products, not just adopted AI tools.
  • Operational excellence mindset. Strong grounding in SRE practices: SLOs and SLIs, observability, incident management and on-call culture for systems that directly touch customers.
  • Customer communication or personalisation domain fluency, or a strong aptitude to build it quickly. Experience with CRM, messaging, customer data or personalisation systems, and with measuring impact through experimentation, is a strong plus.
  • Cross-functional collaboration. You work comfortably with Product, Marketing and CRM teams, and translate business outcomes into engineering priorities and back.
  • Clear communication across disciplines, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.
  • Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.

Nice to have

  • Experience taking a newly modernised platform from rollout to stable, self-service operation at scale.
  • Experience building or scaling AI agents that make customer-facing decisions, with impact measured against a control group.
  • Familiarity with consent, privacy and deliverability requirements for customer communication across multiple countries.
  • A background in subscription, e-commerce or consumer businesses operating in many markets.
  • Experience introducing new messaging channels, including conversational ones.

What we offer

  • Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
  • Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
  • Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
  • Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
  • Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
  • Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
  • Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
  • Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.

The Role:

 

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 


What You Will Work On:
 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
  • A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

description: Über Vestlane und die Rolle Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Du baust lieber einen Prozess, der ein Problem dauerhaft löst, als es jede Woche neu zu lösen? Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools und Automatisierung so selbstverständlich wie andere mit Excel? Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins, direkter Draht zu Steuerberatung, Dienstleistern und Partnern, und ein Überblick über ein wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen, den dir kein Konzern bietet. 2–3 Tage pro Woche arbeitet ihr gemeinsam vor Ort im Raum Erfurt/Weimar, an einem Arbeitsplatz, den du von Anfang an mit aufbaust; den Rest flexibel aus dem Home-Office. Deine Aufgaben Die interne Maschine bauen (dein Schwerpunkt): Du dokumentierst, standardisierst und automatisierst unsere internen Abläufe – von einem Wiki, das tatsächlich gelesen wird, über KI-Agenten für wiederkehrende Aufgaben bis zur Verwaltung unserer Tool- und Vendorlandschaft (Verträge, Zugänge, Kosten). Du erkennst, wo wir Zeit verlieren, und beseitigst die Ursache. Entscheidungen vorbereiten: Du baust Analysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für COO und CEO – Unit Economics, Markt- und Wettbewerbsrecherchen, Investorenreporting – und lieferst Zahlen statt Meinungen. Finance und Accounting unterstützen: Du übernimmst die vorbereitende Buchhaltung, prüfst und stellst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlungsläufe vor, arbeitest unserer Steuerberatung zu und hältst Kosten- und Liquiditätsübersichten aktuell. Compliance-Operations am Laufen halten: Du pflegst Nachweise und Richtlinien für ISO 27001 und SOC 2, bereitest Audits vor und hältst unsere Subprozessorenliste und Fristen in Ordnung. Hiring und HR mittragen: Du schreibst Stellenanzeigen, screenst Bewerbungen, koordinierst Interviews und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen sauber onboarded werden – von Arbeitsvertrag und Equipment bis zum ersten Tag. Daneben hältst du unsere HR-Prozesse und -Tools in Ordnung. Verträge und Angebote im Griff behalten: Du bereitest Angebote vor, hältst unsere Pipeline in Salesforce aktuell und behältst Kunden-, Partner- und Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge im Blick – Versionen, Fristen, Unterschriften. Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht oder vergleichbar) oder eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung. Ob frisch von der Uni oder mit ein bis zwei Jahren Erfahrung aus Startup, Beratung oder Finanzbranche: Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen, Haltung zählt mehr. Sehr sicher in Excel/Google Sheets, strukturiert in Dokumentation und Projektmanagement. Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Buchhaltungs- oder Automatisierungstools (z. B. Zapier, Make, n8n) ist ein Plus. Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT o. ä.) nicht nur zum Texten, sondern um Prozesse zu bauen – und du weißt, wo du selbst prüfen musst. Fließendes Deutsch und gutes Englisch – Partner, Dienstleister und Teile des Teams arbeiten auf Englisch. Präzision und Pragmatismus: Du arbeitest selbstständig, fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, und weißt, wann es auf jedes Detail ankommt – und wann nicht. Du hast kein Problem damit, morgens eine Rechnung zu prüfen und nachmittags ein Bewerbungsgespräch zu organisieren. Breite ist für dich kein Mangel an Fokus, sondern die Chance, das ganze Unternehmen zu verstehen und zu Lernen. Interesse an Fonds, Finanzregulierung oder Compliance ist willkommen, Vorwissen keine Voraussetzung – das bringen wir dir bei. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Zuarbeiter:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Vorteile Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen 2–3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort im Raum Erfurt/Weimar an einem Arbeitsplatz, den du mit dem COO gemeinsam aufbaust, sonst Home-Office; dazu Office-Möglichkeiten an unseren weiteren Standorten und flexible Arbeitszeiten Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor Abschluss Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum gerade diese Rolle und warum gerade Vestlane. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen. Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat zwei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Danach bekommst du kurz vor dem zweiten Termin eine kleine praktische Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag, die du uns in 45 Minuten vorstellst – damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest und wie du Ergebnisse auf den Punkt bringst. Insgesamt weniger als anderthalb Stunden Gesprächszeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung. Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns! description:
Hardware Design Senior Manager 

Bristol, UK

About the job

Lead the engineers behind the power, timing and control circuits that make Graphcore’s AI compute hardware work.

Your team’s schematics, component choices and electrical constraints will give PCB layout engineers complete inputs for implementing each design. You’ll help test and manufacturing teams understand expected behaviour, resolve circuit issues and take hardware through to production.

You’ll line-manage engineers, coach their development and agree achievable commitments, matching the work to available capacity. You’ll coordinate reviews and investigations, ensure corrective actions reach closure and plan ahead for tools, licences and compute resources.

Grow your leadership across the hardware lifecycle, drawing on specialist expertise rather than becoming the technical authority for every circuit. Build a more autonomous team whose methods and shared knowledge improve how Graphcore develops its next generation of hardware.

The team and culture

You’ll connect Hardware Design with SI/PI, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, systems and firmware engineers across locations. Programme management owns the integrated plan; you’ll flag competing priorities early and bring practical options for resolving them.

Technical owners help agree operating conditions, margins and acceptance criteria. You’ll encourage engineers to challenge assumptions, using evidence and specialist advice to resolve difficult trade-offs.

What we’re looking for

  • People leadership that develops engineers, delegates effectively and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.
  • Experience coordinating engineering delivery with programme management, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, with sound judgement under schedule pressure.
  • Communication that builds relationships across disciplines and locations, resolves competing expectations and secures decisions by explaining risks and trade-offs.
  • A strong hardware engineering background spanning circuit and schematic development, board implementation, verification and production transition. An engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Understanding of power supplies, sequencing, reset, clocks, digital interfaces and SI/PI constraints, with judgement about when specialist input is needed.
  • Experience organising technical reviews, maintaining traceable design records and ensuring investigations and corrective actions reach a clear conclusion.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Ready to lead the engineers shaping Graphcore’s AI compute hardware? Apply for the Hardware Design Team Lead role in Bristol.

You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business.
