Build and diversify our capacity panel Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers. Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement. Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year. Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk. 2. Build strong carrier partnerships Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level. Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations. Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels. Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time. Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market. 3. Shape products and build the function Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products. Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications. Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution. Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting. Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk. Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows. What you’ll bring: At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier. A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement. Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers. A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications. Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market. The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail. Fluent English. Strong advantage: Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures. Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z. Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment. German or French proficiency. Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function. If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻 Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹 Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫 Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️ Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂 Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. Step 4 - Our culture connect Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision. Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate. Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508 Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals Fluent English, written and spoken Preferred qualifications and personal profile Nice to have Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification Personal profile Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end Start date: Immediately Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Customer-facing at heart.
Du bist gerne im direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen, ob am Telefon oder im Meeting. Du hörst zu, verstehst, was dein Gegenüber braucht, und stellst dich auf jede Person individuell ein.

Du wartest nicht auf Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen. Du übernimmst Aufgaben, treibst sie selbst voran und stellst Fragen, wenn du sie brauchst.

Fluent German.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch, denn die meisten deiner Kundengespräche finden auf Deutsch statt.

description:

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Du bearbeitest warme Inbound-Anfragen und akquirierst gleichzeitig eigenständig neue Leads, vereinbarst und führst Demo-Termine durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Who We Want

Recent Graduate with an Interest in B2B Sales.
Du hast dein Studium (z.B. BWL, Kommunikation, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar) kürzlich abgeschlossen und bringst Interesse am B2B-Vertrieb mit.

Strong communicator.
Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Self-Confident.
Du glaubst an deine Fähigkeit, ein Gespräch zu führen und abzuschließen, ohne dabei arrogant zu wirken.

Self-Starter.
Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf, statt auf eingehende Leads zu warten, und nutzt eine ruhige Woche, um noch aktiver zu prospektieren.

Coachable.
Du nimmst direktes Feedback an, ohne defensiv zu werden, und wendest es sichtbar im nächsten Gespräch an.

Resilient.
Du erholst dich schnell von einem verlorenen Deal oder einer schwierigen Woche und hältst deine Aktivität konstant hoch.

Fast Learner.
Du arbeitest dich schnell in ein technisches Produkt ein und kannst es Kund:innen verständlich erklären.

Structured.
Du hältst deine Pipeline sauber und deine CRM-Notizen zuverlässig, ohne dass man dir hinterherlaufen muss.

Who We Don’t Want

Relies on leads being handed over.
Du bist darauf angewiesen, dass Leads dir zugeteilt werden, und kannst oder willst nicht selbst aktiv Kund:innen akquirieren.

Gets defensive with feedback.
Du reagierst bei direktem Feedback defensiv, statt es anzunehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Weak written communication.
Du drückst dich schriftlich nicht klar und professionell aus.

In it for the paycheck alone.
Du jagst nur dem Gehalt hinterher und bringst kein echtes Interesse am Handwerk des Verkaufens mit.

Pipeline & Outbound (ca. 20%)

  • Du entscheidest mit, welche Branchen und Accounts sich lohnen, und findest heraus, welche Ansprache funktioniert

Discovery & Demos (ca. 60%)

Closing & Forecast (ca. 20%)

  • Was du in Kundengesprächen hörst, gibst du an Marketing und Produkt weiter

Customer Success Team: für die Übergabe nach erfolgreichem Abschluss und einen reibungslosen Start ins Onboarding

Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Diversität Unternehmen besser macht. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerber:innen. Unabhängig von Gender, Herkunft, Nationalität oder Glaube. Fühl dich frei und schicke uns gerne deine Bewerbung!

description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm. Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! “KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus. Deine Aufgaben Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform. Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten. Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können. Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last. Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um. Dein Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts. Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus. Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung. Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Benefits bei Vestlane Teammitglied mit klarem Entwicklungspfad, wenn der Kundenstamm wächst Direkter Kundenkontakt ab Tag eins, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Menschen, für die deine Arbeit zählt Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (z. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung. Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

 

What you’ll do 

  • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
  • Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
  • Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
  • Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
  • Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

  • Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.

  • Nice to haves: 
    • hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch
    • knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.


What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

 

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

 

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

 

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country they reside in.
  • Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more.
  • Projects Logistics: 
    • Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. 
    • Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves.
    • Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications.

 

Application process

  1. Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis.
  2. Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies.
  3. Join the Collective: Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship.

description:
Who/What is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible
business impact.
With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

 

The role:
 
We are looking for a Manager who leads strategy and architecture projects focused on GenAI solutions. You will own the design of architectures and solutions end to end, balancing business value, technology choices and economics across every dimension of the decision.
You will lead development teams, present solutions to C-level stakeholders and run technical and strategic workshops independently.
 
Key responsibilities:
Project and programme leadership
  • Lead strategy and architecture projects on GenAI, from scoping and business case through to solution design and rollout oversight.
  • Own project plans, budgets, risks and quality, ensuring delivery against client objectives.
  • Shape proposals, estimates and demos, and identify follow-on opportunities with clients.
GenAI architecture and solution design
  • Design GenAI architectures and solutions: RAG, agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, MCP and A2A integration, copilots and assistants.
  • Select and combine cloud-native AI services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks) with third-party and custom components.
  • Apply GenAI to support functions such as HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, redesigning processes and operating models around the new solutions.
Cross-dimension optimization and trade-offs
  • Orchestrate decisions across make, buy and customization options, weighing capex against opex and total cost of ownership.
  • Assess the impact of tool and architecture choices on vendor lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Translate these trade-offs into clear recommendations that business and IT leaders can act on.
Team and stakeholder leadership
  • Guide development teams technically: set the architecture, review solutions and unblock delivery.
  • Present solutions and recommendations to C-level audiences.
  • Run technical and strategic workshops independently, from discovery to design and prioritization.
  • Coach and develop consultants and architects in the team.
Requirements:
  • At least 8 years of professional experience in IT.
  • At least 3 years on AI/GenAI architecture and solution design projects.
  • Prior hands-on background as an engineer or developer.
  • Proven experience applying GenAI to support functions (HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance or IT).
  • Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.
  • Track record of managing projects and leading teams, including development teams.
  • Experience presenting to C-level stakeholders and running workshops independently.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
Technical and functional skills:
  • GenAI architectures: RAG, agentic and multi-agent patterns, LLMOps, model evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.
  • Agent protocols and copilots: MCP, A2A, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, custom assistants and their integration with enterprise systems.
  • Cloud AI platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks and the native data and AI services of Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Architecture trade-offs: make vs buy vs customize, capex vs opex, TCO, lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Support functions: processes and operating models in HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, and how GenAI changes them.
  • Delivery leadership: agile methods, technical team guidance, solution review, programme governance.
  • Business: business cases, value tracking, and the ability to translate technical choices into economic impact for executives.
Nice to have:
  • German not strictly required.
  • Cloud or AI certifications (e.g. Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning).
What we offer:
  • A leadership role bridging strategy, architecture and GenAI delivery, with direct impact on client decisions.
  • International projects on GenAI, agentic systems and support function transformation.
  • A growth path towards senior programme and practice leadership roles.
  • Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.
  • Highly competitive compensation package.

 

This position is based in Zürich.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution.

description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm. Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen. Deine Aufgaben Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung. SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird. LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand. Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert. Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements. Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen. Dein Profil 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist. Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen. Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool. Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst. Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt. Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. description: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit richting architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

You should apply if:

  • You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.
  • You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.
  • You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.
  • You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.
  • You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.
  • You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.

In this role you will:

  • Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.
  • Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.
  • Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.
  • Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.
  • Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.
  • Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.

Advantageous:

  • Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.
  • Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.
  • Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.
  • Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
€132.000—€132.000 EUR

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role 

As Principal Data Engineer, you will own the intraday and end-of-day data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its downstream consumers. You will shape the architecture, standards and engineering practices that enable teams across the business to access trusted, timely and well-defined data. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with the opportunity to influence how the business builds and uses its data platform. 

This will be a full-time role, based in our London office, owning the following responsibilities: 

  • Own the intraday and EOD data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its consumers, including Market Risk, Credit Risk, Treasury, Finance, Reporting and desk tools. 
  • Design and maintain robust data schemas and serving contracts, including SQL, APIs and Kafka-based distribution. 
  • Define data versioning and reproducibility patterns, including as-of timestamps and run IDs, snapshots and incremental updates, with appropriate treatment of position and P&L data. 
  • Own the CTRM-to-warehouse data pipeline, ensuring reliable ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery to downstream consumers. 
  • Lead the implementation and production use of the data warehouse serving layer, closing out the current proof of concept and turning it into a production-ready platform. 
  • Set engineering standards for data modelling, schema evolution, data quality, observability, testing and operational support. 
  • Build and operate solutions using relevant platform technologies, including ClickHouse, S3, Kafka and schema registry tooling. 
  • Work closely with stakeholder teams to understand their needs, propose solutions, explain trade-offs and establish clear, dependable data contracts. 
  • Provide technical leadership to the data engineering team, raising the quality of design and implementation while encouraging collaboration, constructive challenge and continuous improvement. 
  • Help shape the longer-term data architecture and engineering approach as the business and its data requirements evolve.

 

About You 

You will be a technically strong and proactive data engineering leader who can turn complex business requirements into robust, scalable data products. You are comfortable supporting multiple teams, bringing forward clear recommendations and new ideas, and engaging constructively when your designs are challenged. You want to help shape the future data architecture of the business, not simply deliver against a predefined specification. 

As a result, we believe the following experiences and skills are essential for this role: 

  • Demonstrable experience designing and building data warehouses; this is a non-negotiable requirement. 
  • Hands-on production experience with ClickHouse; this is a non-negotiable requirement. 
  • Experience delivering a columnar OLAP data platform in production, with a strong understanding of analytical query performance and data modelling. 
  • Practical experience with Kafka and event-driven or streaming data architectures. 
  • Strong Python engineering skills and sufficient C# literacy to work effectively with systems and codebases that use C#. 
  • Experience modelling versioned position and P&L data, including point-in-time or as-of views and reproducible runs. 
  • Experience working in a trading or other time-sensitive, data-intensive business environment. 
  • Previous technical leadership, including setting standards and guiding engineering decisions. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to put forward solutions, bring ideas into discussions and engage positively with challenge. 
  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to balance the needs of multiple downstream teams while maintaining coherent platform standards. 

The following experience is not required, but highly desirable for this role: 

  • Experience in commodities trading or energy markets. 
  • Exposure to a Commodity Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) system, such as Orchestrade or Endur. 
  • Familiarity with dbt and/or data quality frameworks. 

 

What we offer 

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.  
  • 25 days of annual holiday entitlement, excluding UK public holidays. 
  • Robust benefits package such as medical, dental, life insurance, generous pension contribution, and supplemental benefits partially subsidised by the Company.  
  • Eligibility to receive external and internal training in accordance with our Training & Development Policy. 

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

description: Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, analytisch sterk en heb je interesse in techniek en automotive? BAS Parts & Tyres is een grote speler in de internationale handel van truckonderdelen en banden. We leveren nieuwe, gebruikte en gereviseerde onderdelen aan klanten in meer dan 100 landen. Met jouw commerciële inzicht en analytische vaardigheden zorg je ervoor dat onze producten goed aansluiten bij de vraag van klanten wereldwijd. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te werken en direct bij te dragen aan het commerciële succes van BAS Parts & Tyres. Wat ga je doen? Als Productmanager ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw productgroepen. Je combineert markt- en data-analyse met inkoop, assortimentsbeheer en samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen productgroepen verder uit te bouwen. Daarbij combineer je analytisch werken met commercie en ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontdekken en benutten van nieuwe kansen. Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk? Bij BAS Parts & Tyres krijg je de kans om zelfstandig aan jouw eigen assortiment te werken. Je hebt direct invloed op welke producten we aanbieden, hoe we deze presenteren en hoe succesvol ze worden verkocht. description: About Quandela Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Description of the Team/Project You will join the QPU Prototyping team, which develops and integrates the optical systems at the heart of Quandela’s quantum processors, turning advanced R&D experiments into operational hardware. Your project will focus on developing active stabilisation and control methods to maintain QPU performance over extended periods. Working at the intersection of experimental quantum optics, instrumentation, automation and data analysis, you will help transform laboratory demonstrations into stable, reliable and operational QPU subsystems. Your Key Responsibilities Characterise the physical mechanisms and environmental drifts that limit optical-system and QPU performance. Develop active feedback methods to stabilise relevant parameters, such as optical phase, polarisation, spectral alignment and timing. Select and integrate suitable sensors, actuators, control electronics and measurement equipment. Develop software for automated calibration, real-time monitoring, feedback control and experimental data acquisition. Optimise system performance and define appropriate metrics, measurement protocols and acceptance criteria. Assess long-term stability, robustness and reproducibility through extended experimental campaigns. Implement automated methods for detecting and recovering from performance degradation. Analyse experimental data, identify limiting factors and propose improvements to the optical and control architectures. Document the system and collaborate with other teams to support its transfer into an operational quantum processor. Requirements Education & Background Currently completing an M2 or final-year engineering degree in physics, photonics, optical engineering, quantum technologies, control engineering or a related field. Previous hands-on experience in experimental optics, quantum optics or laboratory instrumentation is desirable. Technical Skills Proficiency in Python for experimental automation, data acquisition and analysis. Familiarity with optical experiments, laboratory equipment and measurement techniques. Experience with software version control, particularly Git, is desirable. Soft Skills Rigorous and methodical approach to experimental work. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary team. Clear written and verbal communication. Curiosity, initiative and attention to detail. Languages Professional working proficiency in English. Benefits Swile Card (meal vouchers) 🍴🛒 50% participation in transportation costs 🚆 Possibility of remote work 💻 Internship Allowance between €1,200 and €1,400 per month 💰 1,5 days off per month, cumulative 🧳 What we also offer A challenging and innovative work environment at the heart of quantum computing. A diverse and collaborative company culture. Opportunities for professional growth and skill development. At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

Fivetran's SAP connectors move enterprise data out of SAP and into modern data platforms. We're looking for an all-round SAP specialist who combines strong ABAP skills with deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing. You'll work on the interfaces and data extraction mechanisms that let Fivetran reliably pull data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems, and you'll help customers and internal teams get the most out of them.

You will be the SAP specialist within a team of Java developers. Your knowledge and input is crucial to the success of this team. 

 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • ABAP programming using traditional SAPGUI as well as Eclipse (or other IDE).
  • Databases (HANA/Oracle/etc)
  • Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/MS)
  • AI tools Claude/Codex/

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance ABAP components (function modules, classes, CDS views, and enhancements) to drive scalable outbound data extraction from SAP systems.
  • Own and modernize internal SAP test environments to accelerate feature development for current connectors and upcoming public cloud / BTP integrations.
  • Architect robust outbound interfaces leveraging OData, standard and generic DataSources, ODP/ODQ delta frameworks, and RFC connections.
  • Optimize data throughput and reliability across ECC and S/4HANA landscapes by diagnosing and resolving extraction performance bottlenecks and delta synchronization issues.
  • Analyze underlying SAP database structures (HANA and traditional DBs) to unlock efficiency gains and streamline data pipeline performance.
  • Partner closely with engineering, support, and customers to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical architectures.
  • Deliver end-to-end support for enterprise clients by troubleshooting complex connectivity, authorization, and configuration challenges in customer SAP environments.
  • Establish technical design standards, interface specifications, and best practice documentation for internal and external knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging SAP technologies—including SAP Datasphere and BTP—to keep Fivetran’s connectors at the forefront of modern data integration.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with strong ABAP skills (classic and modern ABAP, ABAP OO, ABAP for HANA)
  • Deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing:
    • OData (v2 and v4): service design, SEGW, performance, and security
    • SAP extractors: standard and generic DataSources, delta handling, ODP/ODQ, CDS-based extraction
    • RFC: function modules, BAPIs, destinations, and tRFC/qRFC
  • Solid working knowledge of both SAP ECC and S/4HANA, including the differences in data models and extraction options between them
  • Good knowledge of databases: SQL, query performance and tuning, SAP HANA, and relational database concepts
  • Understanding of SAP data models and key modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD)
  • Experience with SAP authorizations and technical user/role setup for interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English
  • Experience in code reviews, design, troubleshooting and testing
  • Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including connecting SAP to cloud data platforms
  • Java development experience
  • Familiarity with data integration/ELT tools and data warehousing concepts
  • Knowledge of SLT, SAP Datasphere, BW and SAP BTP.

description: About us We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment. Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems. We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace. We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI. The role We recently released Encord Data Labs: our research arm through which we'll be sharing some of the lessons learned from our internal research on how data actually moves model performance in the physical world. We're looking for our first Research Communications Lead, to build and drive our Data Labs research and publishing motion. You won't just be on the author list, you'll be identifying interesting problems and topics to explore, and working with the rest of our ML team to shape their results into research that helps progress our field. This is a front-row seat to some of the most important technical challenges in physical AI, with a direct line to our research team and co-founders, as well as chance to explore the end-to-end journey of building autonomous systems and getting them to work in the real world. A taste of what Data Labs has worked on and published in its first months: EMG-1: we released the largest open dataset of wrist EMG synced with egocentric video: 307 hours of real work captured on head and wrist cameras, plus a 10.4-hour lab set with optical mocap, over 30x larger than the next public dataset of its kind EMG + vision fusion: by adding muscle signals to camera-based hand tracking, we were able to reduce median fingertip error by ~25%, and ~35% when hands were briefly occluded Encord-REACH: we built a video-native 3D hand pose model for egocentric work scenes, now in production with robotics teams; it cuts wrist tracking error by 80% and joint error by 65%, is 30–70% more accurate on industrial gloves, and almost never swaps in a bystander's hand Synthetic data for ANYbotics: using NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory to turn 410 reference images of industrial sites into 1,500+ short clips, we lifted ANYbotics' inspection anomaly recall by 24%, for ~$55 of generation What you'll do Own the Data Labs research ideation: identify interesting and important topics worth dedicating resources to, collaborate with the broader ML team on the research process, and articulate our findings in a clear and compelling way Partner with customers' research teams on joint research and case studies relating to their data pipelines Work hand in hand with our broader ML team to scope, structure and draft research on topics ranging from embodied data collection approaches, to data curation, VLAs and world models Build Data Labs publishing machine: a calendar, a review process with research, and templates for posts, benchmark launches, dataset releases and paper companions Distribute every piece where the broader field can find it: X, LinkedIn, Hugging Face, arXiv companions, newsletters, podcasts and conferences such as CoRL, IROS and NeurIPS Measure what lands, from citations and researcher follow-ups to inbound from physical AI teams, and feed that back into what we publish next Who we're looking for An ML practitioner: you've trained models, built datasets or run experiments, either for personal projects or as part of previous work experience Genuinely excited by physical AI. You read the latest VLA and world-model papers because you want to, and you have opinions about where robot learning data is heading Research taste: you can tell a real result from a noisy one, and you can find the one sentence a post is really about Clear, concrete writing that leads with the finding and the number, and uses charts and video to carry the argument Credibility with researchers: the broader team seek out your opinion, and you can review the underlying technical narrative and content beyond just the language or style An owner who is driven by craft at speed: you turn a half-formed idea in Slack into a published, well-distributed post, driven by a strong sense of self-initiative and solutions-orientation Experience requirements 2+ years in ML research, ML engineering, technical writing or developer relations, with hands-on exposure to computer vision, robotics or multimodal data A public portfolio of technical writing: blog posts, paper companions, tutorials or a newsletter or podcast that researchers have read and shared Working proficiency in Python and the ability to read code, papers and experiment logs well enough to check a claim yourself Experience coordinating with multiple technical contributors to get a piece from idea to launch Bonus: a degree or research experience in robot learning, CV or a related field;
