description: About the team The OpenAI Startups team helps founders build and scale products with AI. We combine technical understanding, commercial judgement and startup ecosystem relationships to help customers move from promising ideas to building and scaling their businesses with OpenAI. About the role You will lead one of our EMEA Greenfield sales teams, helping high-potential startups choose OpenAI, reach production and establish the foundations for growth. Greenfield covers two distinct motions: Early Stage, focused on activation and meaningful expansion, and Pursuits, focused on high-stakes conversion of the startups with highest potential and new customers with complex buying decisions. You will translate regional strategy into clear account priorities, hire and develop Account Directors, and coach the customer and commercial work appropriate to the team you lead. You will work closely with technical partners and VC Partnerships to turn founder access and technical engagement into customer value, qualified pipeline and consumption revenue. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week. In this role, you'll: Recruit, onboard and develop a strong team of Account Directors. Set clear expectations, coach live customer work, sales methodology and deal strategy, as well as giving direct, actionable feedback. Build and execute the Greenfield GTM strategy and sales plan for your team. Prioritise companies using customer need, workload, decision timing, founder and funding signals, commercial potential and available technical capacity. Coach the motion your sellers own. For Early Stage, strengthen discovery, activation, first production use and initial growth. For Pursuits, strengthen competitive strategy, executive access, evaluation, migration planning and negotiation. Create a disciplined pipeline and consumption forecasting rhythm. Connect opportunity stages and revenue expectations to customer evidence, production milestones and specific next decisions. Build trusted relationships with founders, technical leaders and commercial decision-makers. Help the team explain how OpenAI can improve product quality, delivery speed and economics for the customer’s workload. Partner with VC Partnerships, Marketing and developer-facing teams on qualified sourcing and activation. Match direct sales effort, nurture and scaled engagement to customer intent and potential. Align with Solutions and AI Engineering on technical scope, evaluation criteria and support capacity. Bring in Product, Deal Desk, Legal and other partners when their expertise can advance the customer’s decision. Turn technical success into a credible commercial path and sustained paid adoption. Use approved programmes and commercial processes, and ensure customer commitments reflect a realistic production and consumption plan. Build reusable discovery guides, sales plays, competitive playbooks and migration plans. Route routine billing, credits and support requests to the right channels while retaining clear ownership of material customer blockers. Coordinate account transitions with Core and strategic coverage. Preserve customer context, relationships and the next growth plan, and keep ownership clear until a handoff is accepted. We're seeking someone with experience including: Six or more years leading sales teams, including hiring, developing and managing technical sellers in fast-changing markets. Working closely with startups as a founder, early employee or commercial leader serving startup customers. Selling platform or software products in a product-led or consumption-based business, with a record of converting technical adoption into revenue. Leading the relevant Greenfield motion: scalable early-stage acquisition and activation, or complex competitive pursuits and production migrations. Building repeatable sales processes while preserving judgement about customer fit, account priority and the right level of support. Coaching both technical and commercial discovery, qualifying opportunities and managing evidence-based forecasts. Discussing AI applications, APIs, model evaluation and production economics credibly with founders and technical leaders, while drawing on specialist expertise when needed. Working across technical, product, marketing, operational and commercial teams, and translating customer learning into better products and programmes. You might thrive in this role if you: You understand founder urgency, earn trust through useful advice and communicate candidly about what is possible. You need to be comfortable with ambiguity and creating clarity and direction in an ever-changing landscape and priorities. You are curious about AI, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to learn quickly. You enjoy developing sellers and building systems that make a growing team more effective. What success looks like: Your team reaches the right startups early, advances customers into meaningful production use and builds a healthy path to customer value and growth. Qualified pursuits progress through clear technical and commercial decisions. Sellers become more capable, forecasts become more reliable, and the team scales its reach through repeatable programmes and effective handoffs. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. About The Role About the role We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is. What You'll Do What you'll do Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones. Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs. Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows. Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules. Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop. What You Bring What you bring Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review. Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend. BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar. Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience. Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked. Nice To Have Nice to have Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid. Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide. Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus. Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases. What You Will Get In Return Make a genuine impact on the product Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. Work in the EU Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. Become a stock options holder Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. Receive unwavering support and care Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. Work & Swim program Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. Mission Brief 

Join us in building the systems and software that empowers our engineering and operation departments to analyze flight data and make data-driven decisions. As a Data & Backend Software Engineer, you will help transform large volumes of structured and unstructured data into reliable, accessible, and actionable information. Your work will enable data-driven decision-making across the company and unlock insights that drive innovation and operational excellence. 

 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

As part of our Data and Analytics team, you will design, develop, and operate the systems that ingest, process, store, and serve data at scale. 

 

You will: 

  • Build modern, scalable, and high-performance solutions for our engineering and operation platform. 
  • Strong understanding and at least 6 years of hands-on experience in one of the following languages: C#, Java, Rust, Python.  
  • Define data ingestion, processing, storage, and access patterns to ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability. 
  • Develop data services, APIs, pipelines, and data products that make data available to engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. 
  • Design and implement robust ETL/ELT processes to ingest and transform data from a wide variety of sources. 
  • Contribute to data architecture, modeling, and storage decisions to ensure consistency, availability, low latency, and long-term sustainability of the platform. 
  • Ensure data quality and integrity through validation processes, monitoring, and adherence to data governance principles. 
  • Provide observability and monitoring of platform components, enabling rapid detection and resolution of issues. 
  • Author and maintain architectural documentation, technical specifications, and user-facing documentation. 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver impactful solutions. 
  • Guide less experienced engineers by sharing your knowledge and know-how, promoting engineering best practices and continuous learning. 

 

Qualification Checklist  

  • A degree in software engineering, computer science, data science or similar  
  • Strong experience with batch and streaming data processing 
  • Good understanding of time-series data concepts, including sampling rates, decimation, signal integrity, and frequency-domain analysis 
  • Practical experience in optimizing and efficient implementation of native data processing and DataFrame-based processing 
  • Excellent skills in querying, transforming, and optimizing large-scale datasets 
  • Solid understanding of modern data architectures, including Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and Medallion Architecture patterns 
  • Hands-on experience with analytical storage technologies such as Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg 
  • Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven architectures 
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, or Snowflake 
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including maintainability, testing, and automation 
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking concepts, and platform operations 
  • Experience with Protobuf encoding and columnar file formats (Parquet, Arrow, Zarr, Arrow Flight) 
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, and telemetry solutions 
  • Experience with OLAP databases and/or TSDBs (like ClickHouse, Apache Druid, InfluxDB) 
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively and collaborate across disciplines 

 

Bonus Skills:  

  • Experience working with large-scale engineering, manufacturing, or telemetry datasets. 
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
  • Experience with stream processing frameworks like Apache Flink

Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren. Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken. Wat bieden wij? Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou: + Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring. + Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling. + 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur). + Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden. + Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie. + Een professioneel en hardwerkend team, waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan. + Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf Over Whitevision Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen. Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig. Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen. Doorgroeimogelijkheden Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. description:
Mission Brief

As a Senior Launch Operations Engineer, you’ll join the team in Germany that shapes how our missions come to life. From the moment a campaign is conceived, you are the one aligning global launch sites, synchronizing teams and defining the operational path that ultimately determines how—and whether—the rocket leaves the ground. 

Within the global Launch Operations team, you stand at the core of our mission: transforming complex campaigns into repeatable, scalable and reliable operations over multiple launch sites. Your work creates the structure that enables teams across the world to execute with confidence and precision. 

When a campaign moves from planning to execution, you step directly into the field—joining local teams on site, leading coordination efforts in the company, and operations both inside and outside the control room. In these moments, you carry the responsibility of turning months of preparation into a successful launch day. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Coordinate and prepare launch and stage acceptance campaigns end‑to‑end, ensuring full launch system readiness. Over time, you can grow into a test or launch director role for dedicated missions.  
  • Develop a deep understanding of our launch system to make sound operational decisions, even under pressure. You use this knowledge to guide local teams and maintain global alignment. 
  • Own mission‑level configuration management, keeping design, manufacturing, assembly and testing tightly aligned with mission goals. Your decisions set the operational envelope long before the rocket reaches the pad. 
  • As our launch cadence grows and additional sites come online, you will contribute to our team shaping the future of multi‑site launch operations and define how our global team executes missions. 
  • Feeding flight experience directly back into engineering teams, ensuring that operational insights continuously improve our system design. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • At least five years of experience in the space sector or a comparable high‑stakes environment, with a strong background in mission or operational roles, ideally including launch‑related responsibilities 
  • Degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical engineering or a comparable engineering discipline 
  • System-level technical understanding of launch vehicles and their subsystems 
  • Demonstrated autonomy and a solution-oriented mindset 
  • Experience in multidisciplinary troubleshooting and cross‑functional coordination 
  • Ability to maintain clarity and performance in high‑stress, long‑duration operational settings 
  • Strong organizational discipline, situational awareness, and ability to lead within diverse teams 
  • Comfortable working self‑sufficiently and adapting quickly to highly dynamic environments 
  • Willingness to travel to global launch sites for multi‑week campaign deployments 
  • Fluent in English  

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Public transport ticket: Commute with ease using a fully financed Deutschlandticket
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team        

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

Want to find out more about us?

Visit www.isaraerospace.com

 

Data Protection

We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. For detailed information on how your data is processed, including your rights, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

 

Disclaimer

Isar Aerospace SE is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. We use Metaview to record interview audio so our team can review it later and stay focused during the conversation. We will record interviews only if you opt in. description:
The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

About HelloFresh

HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!

Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents. 

Our more than 15,000 employees from over 70+ nationalities are the heart and soul of our diverse, fast-paced and dynamic environment where innovation and smart, fast action is encouraged. 

We will encourage you to make an immediate impact in your area of work as well as empower you to grow your career with us.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will work directly with the Director of Strategic Projects and VP of STARK to drive key strategic initiatives and high-impact operational engagements across Europe. Our team operates at the intersection of strategy, defence engineering, and scale-up execution to rapidly deploy modern defense technologies. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads, production specialists, and external stakeholders in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Manager of Strategic Projects, you will support the Director of Strategic Projects and make an important contribution to the analysis, design, and implementation of business performance approaches. You will develop tailor-made solutions and work closely with the Director of Strategic Projects, VP, and C-level to ensure positive impact and sustainable results.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Support the Director of Strategic Projects, VP, and C-level in driving key strategic initiatives and high-impact operational engagements across Europe.
  • Analyze, design, and implement business performance approaches to deliver measurable impact in contested environments.
  • Develop tailor-made operational solutions for complex defense challenges, including manufacturing capacity assessments and supply chain optimizations.
  • Structure ambiguous operational, industrial, and strategic challenges into executable workstreams and actionable roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across engineering, production, and procurement to maintain alignment and hit aggressive project milestones.
  • Communicate findings, strategic risks, and status updates directly to senior leadership, project leads, and external stakeholders.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, with strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong execution focus as an individual contributor, with high attention to detail and a high sense of responsibility in handling routine operational tasks.
  • Ability to independently structure ambiguous tasks into actionable steps while supporting cross-functional team initiatives.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Kyiv, Ukraine, with willingness to travel as needed.

NICE TO HAVE

Prior exposure to defense technologies, aerospace manufacturing, or hardware production programs.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Serve as a senior strategic partner to EU Sales leadership, key retail accounts, and cross-functional stakeholders, aligning trade marketing investments and initiatives with commercial priorities, retailer needs, and regional growth opportunities. Manage regional trade marketing budgets and performance measurement, leveraging sales data, retailer insights, and campaign results to evaluate ROI, optimize investments, and identify opportunities to improve retail performance. QUALIFICATIONS: 8+ years of experience in trade marketing, retail marketing, channel marketing, or related commercial marketing functions, ideally within consumer technology, consumer electronics, premium lifestyle, or similarly fast-paced consumer brands. Strong understanding of the European retail landscape, including major retail partners, omnichannel marketing strategies, regional market dynamics, and localization requirements. Strong commercial and analytical acumen, with experience managing marketing budgets, evaluating campaign effectiveness, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to influence senior internal leaders and external retail partners across multiple markets. description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early. Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations. Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers. Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria. Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering. Requirements You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units. You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection. You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts. You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline. You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers. You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar. You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. ** This position is available remotely in one of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

description:
Mission Brief 

You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds. 

We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire. 

This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

 

SASE and Network Security 

  • Own and operate our SASE platform, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies. 
  • Drive firewall security with the network team: own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices. 
  • Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection. 
  • Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions, including our edge and CDN-based protection services. 

Security Posture and Hardening 

  • Apply CIS Benchmarks to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite. 
  • Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis. 
  • Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find. 
  • Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan. 

Detection and Visibility 

  • Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances. 
  • Build and maintain detections in our SIEM and apply MITRE ATT&CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC. 
  • Extend visibility into OT with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling. 
  • Act as an L3 incident responder for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration. 

Security Stack and Automation 

  • Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms as their technical owner. 
  • Script and build internal tooling in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves. 

Design and Engineering Partnership 

  • Design what you operate: run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against. 
  • Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys. 
  • Embed security with engineering: partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Experience: 10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work. 
  • Architect Spirit: you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself. 
  • SASE: hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it. 
  • Hardening: experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management. 
  • Networking and Firewalls: solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services. 
  • Security Stack Depth: strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort. 
  • Detection Engineering: practical MITRE ATT&CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures. 
  • Operational Depth: strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents. 
  • Automation: scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience. 
  • IT and OT: comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus. 
  • Autonomy: operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others. 
  • Mentoring: mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts as technical lead in cross-functional projects. 
  • Communication: clear communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical risk for a range of audiences and to work controls through other teams. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or the equivalent through relevant certifications and hands-on experience. 

Bonus Skills 

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, energy, manufacturing or other OT-heavy, safety-critical environments. 
  • Prior SOC or incident response team experience. 
  • Cloud security depth in a major public cloud and its native security services. 
  • Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST. 
  • Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued.

  • Impact: the opportunity to directly protect the future of spaceflight as we approach our first orbital launch.

As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

In this role, you will bring Frontline into new internal and customer projects, take ownership of technical integration, and build trust through technical excellence rather than project management. We support each other as a team and work closely across disciplines to achieve our mission.

When something fails in the field, you will be on-site to diagnose and resolve the issue under time pressure, working directly alongside the customer.

You will work at the intersection of software, hardware, and operational reality: setting up the C++ backend that orchestrates UAV swarms, integrating new platforms into live systems, and ensuring command-and-control processes function seamlessly in isolated, bandwidth-constrained tactical environments.

  • Install, configure, and commission Minerva Frontline in customer operational environments, working with edge hardware, restricted networks, and tactical infrastructure.

  • Develop custom tooling, scripts, diagnostic tools, and test environments to make deployments reproducible, efficient, and robust.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20/23) with proven experience reading, debugging, and customizing production C++ codebases.
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating complex real-time distributed systems using technologies such as gRPC, Flatbuffers, WebSockets, MAVLink, or MAVSDK.
  • Demonstrated track record of deploying software solutions to external customers and collaborating with hardware teams during flight tests and platform integrations.
  • Willingness to travel regularly within Germany (up to 40%).

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with ROS / ROS 2, PX4, ArduPilot, or autonomous robotics systems.
  • Previous experience in the defence sector, aerospace, or with military unmanned systems.
  • Proficiency with containerization and CI/CD tools tailored for edge devices (Docker, Podman, Yocto, embedded Linux, systemd).
  • Familiarity with tactical mesh networking, RF communications, or bandwidth-constrained radio link protocols.
  • Active German / NATO security clearance or prior experience working in security-cleared environments.

Wat ga je doen?

Stage lopen bij Burson betekent dat je meteen veel verantwoordelijkheden krijgt. Als stagiair maak je écht onderdeel uit van ons team en word je zoveel mogelijk betrokken bij verschillende activiteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s aan opdrachten voor merken zoals SharkNinja, Jaguar Land Rover en Procter & Gamble (o.a. Gillette, Always en Olay). Afhankelijk van de klanten in jouw portfolio ondersteun je bijvoorbeeld bij andere inhoudelijke taken als het verzamelen van relevante informatie, het maken van media-, concurrentie- of stakeholderanalyses, het meedenken over de invulling van nieuwe social media- of influencer-campagnes en het creëren van content voor verschillende kanalen. Er wordt hard gewerkt in de diverse klantteams, maar de werksfeer is open, informeel en eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd!

Wie zijn wij?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Wij helpen bedrijven en organisaties in de meest uiteenlopende en vaak uitdagende omstandigheden, waarbij wij ze adviseren in hun transities en transformaties. Met het creëren van stakeholderacceptatie als doel. Nooit om de status quo te beschermen, niet om op elke hype in te gaan, maar om ze met een gegronde strategie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Onze adviseurs zijn met hun brede ervaring, vakmanschap en integriteit erkende boardroompartners. Onafhankelijk en kritisch zetten zij de discussie met onze opdrachtgevers op scherp. Burson heeft jarenlange ervaring in het adviseren van bedrijven in complexe situaties, onder meer op het gebied van strategie, stakeholdermanagement en geloofwaardige communicatie.

We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Wie ben jij?

Heb jij je altijd al afgevraagd hoe het is om stage te lopen bij een internationaal communicatiebureau? Ben je goed op de hoogte van het laatste nieuws? Weet je je weg te vinden in de onlinewereld? Ben je communicatief vaardig, leergierig en stel je altijd de juiste vragen? Dan past deze stage perfect bij jou.

Je staat open voor nieuwe ideeën en opvattingen, bent breed geïnteresseerd en zoekt graag dingen tot op de bodem uit. Bij ons zijn studenten van alle studieachtergronden welkom die geïnteresseerd zijn in communicatie, marketing en media.

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Unsere Steuerungstechniker:innen für Projekte begleiten eine Anlage bis zur Abnahme. Danach übernimmst Du: Du verantwortest die Steuerungstechnik unserer Anlagen im Betrieb – bei Retrofit-Projekten, Änderungen und im Service. Dafür brauchst Du dasselbe Können wie im Projektgeschäft, nur setzt Du es an bestehenden Anlagen ein, die oft anders aussehen als auf dem Plan. Wenn Du nicht einfach Störungen beheben, sondern Ursachen verstehen, Lösungen konzipieren und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, bist Du bei uns richtig. Deine Aufgaben Elektrokonstruktion Erstellung komplexer Stromlaufpläne für Retrofit-Projekte und Anlagenänderungen (eXs-CAD) gemäss Konzept Aufnahme und Nachführung bestehender Schemas, auch bei Fremdfabrikaten und lückenhafter Dokumentation Automationsplanung Verantwortung für Steuerungslösungen in Retrofit- und Service-Projekten Unterstützung bei der Erarbeitung von Retrofit-Konzepten inkl. Umschaltplan und Rückfallebene, abgestimmt mit dem Projektleiter Integration von Notstromanlagen in übergeordnete Systeme (SPS, Leitsysteme, Gebäudeautomation) Steuerungssysteme Programmierung und Anpassung von SPS-Programmen, auch in fremden und älteren Systemen Parametrierung und Optimierung von Generatorsteuerungen (z. B. ComAp, Cummins PCC) Anpassung und Optimierung von Netzersatz-, Synchronisations- und Lastmanagementfunktionen Service, Tests und Inbetriebnahme Analyse umfassender Störungen vor Ort und Ableitung nachhaltiger Lösungen Test von Änderungen im Prüffeld und Inbetriebnahme nach Retrofits und Anlagenänderungen beim Kunden Durchführung anspruchsvoller Prüfungen der Steuerungs- und Elektrotechnik Dokumentation und Standards Sicherstellung einer sauberen, nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation aller Änderungen Rückmeldung von Erfahrungen aus dem Feld ans Engineering zur Weiterentwicklung von Standards Team und Zusammenarbeit Übernahme der Anlagen von den Projekt-Steuerungstechniker:innen nach der Abnahme Fachliche Unterstützung der Servicetechniker:innen bei steuerungstechnischen Fragen Technische Ansprechperson für Kunden, Betreiber und Projektleitende im After-Sales Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Automation oder vergleichbar Weiterbildung (z.B. HF Systemtechnik oder ähnlich) von Vorteil Erfahrung in der Steuerungstechnik im industriellen Umfeld Fundierte Erfahrung in Inbetriebnahme, Fehlersuche und im Umgang mit komplexen Anlagen Erfahrung im Schema-Engineering (vorzugsweise eXs) – Du erstellst Schemas, nicht nur Änderungen Erfahrung mit SPS-Systemen Erfahrung mit Umbauten oder Modernisierungen bestehender Anlagen Erfahrung mit Generatorsteuerungen von Vorteil Kenntnisse in der Integration von Anlagen und Systemen Gute Kenntnisse von Stromnetzen, Netzformen und Netzverhalten Sicheres und kundenorientiertes Auftreten Lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Qualitätsbewusstsein Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch- und Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil Führerausweis Kategorie B Reisebereitschaft ca. 50 % Pikettdienst Was Dich auszeichnet Systemisches Denken – Du erkennst Zusammenhänge, auch an Anlagen, die Du nicht selbst gebaut hast Analytische Stärke – Du findest Ursachen, nicht nur Symptome Hands-on & pragmatisch – Du bist gerne dort, wo die Anlage steht Ruhe beim Kunden – Du behältst den Überblick, wenn etwas nicht läuft, und erklärst verständlich, was Du tust Umsetzungsstärke – Du bringst Dinge zu Ende Bist Du das? description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

The Role: Imagine selling a solution that will predict for your customers (with an 85% accuracy) who is going to buy, what they’ll buy and when.  As a Strategic Account Executive at 6sense, you’ll be an instrumental player to our growth as we build upon the success we’ve had delivering predictions for enterprises like Cisco, Centrify, Dell, Qlik, and Oracle.  We will trust you to evangelize 6sense, run your business like a CEO, and consistently exceed quarterly and annual targets.  This is not your average start-up; you’ll be closing large deals.  And you’ll be rewarded very well for doing so.

The Fit: We’re looking for hunters who not only have a track record of being the best of the best, closing big deals and passion for fundamentally changing B2B marketing and sales, but can also think critically about driving customer growth and building our sales organization.  This is a unique opportunity to help shape and accelerate our success.

Here are the traits you exhibit;

  • Intrinsic drive to be successful, love to win – You’ll take initiative to figure it out, are motivated to do your absolute best work. (That’s why you’ve ended up at top across your career.)
  • Clear, succinct communicator – Using your customer’s language, you’ll help them clearly understand the value 6sense delivers
  • Technical expertise – You’ll demonstrate and speak to how 6sense drives success
  • Innately curious – You’ll know your buyer, their business, and what 6sense means to their success
  • Empathetic listener – You’ll listen more than you talk. And, you really get what they mean. 
  • Collaborate and win as a team – You’ll compete, but above that you’ll collaborate, you’ll share what is working, you’ll help the team win, you’ll take on projects outside of closing deals.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 7+ years of quota carrying software or technology sales, closing complex sales cycles
  • Consistent track record of over-achieving quota (top 10-20% of company)
  • Experience closing transactions >$250k ACV to line of business executives
  • Experience bringing on net-new logos

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience selling to Enterprise CMOs, VPs Demand Gen, Marketing Operations, Sales leaders
  • Experience closing $1M+ transactions
  • Familiarity with marketing tech stack (Marketo, Eloqua), b2b publishers/media, data providers
  • Strong and demonstrated written and verbal communications skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment
  • 4-year BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong C-level customer references

6sense is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. We will process your personal data for the purposes of the recruitment exercise, which may include assessing your suitability for the role, background, and reference checks, where applicable. Please see our recruitment privacy policy for more information: Recruitment Privacy Notice

Our Benefits: 

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. 

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to  

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the ----- domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

description: Why this role exists Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel. Tacto's sales-led motion in DACH works: more than 300 industrial companies run on Tacto. Tacto Labs is where we build what comes nest: new products and wedges that don't scale linearly with headcount. Each bet starts on a whiteboard and either becomes a real business inside Tacto or gets killed fast. What you'll do Take a bet from idea to first paying users, working directly with our founders Build it yourself with AI: prototype, landing pages, agents, outreach, whatever proves or kills the idea fastest Talk to customers and suppliers until you know. more about the problem than anyone else in the company Find the next compounding loop and scale what works How it fits Everybody in Tacto Labs is a Builder: same role, same bar, pointed at earlier stage problems. We believe in building over strategizing. Who we're looking for You've built something from zero: as a founder, early at a startup, or during a side project. You want to found something someday. We're looking for people we'd back if they did. You don't come from engineering? Great, as long as you build. If you've shipped something with with AI tools, you're technical enough to start and get better. Extreme ownership, no ego. Fluent in German; English is a strong plus. How the process works Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role Hiring Manager Interview (45 min) On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min) How we work We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity. Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. What We Offer The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have: Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation. description: Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling. Wat ga je doen? In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren. Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust. De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW) Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare. Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen. Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken. In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses. In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer. Als teamleider … Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig. Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders. Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team. Als R&D Engineer… Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten. In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls. Verantwoordelijkheden Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW; Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken; Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt; Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren; Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica); Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie; Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau); Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden; In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht. Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of . Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal. Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. De teamleider is een parttime functie. Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Must have skills : SAP Generative AI Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: We are seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to to design, build, and operationalize enterprise-grade SAP GenAI solutions & experience with with the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) & other AI cloud platforms The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in AI Core, Generative AI Hub, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Knowledge Graphs with hands-on experience orchestrating intelligent pipelines using LangChain / LangGraph frameworks, Vector Engines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. You will work with multi-disciplinary teams to embed Generative AI into SAP-centric business applications and processes, ensuring scalability, compliance, and measurable business impact. Prerequisite for RDE: Translate business processes into AI-driven workflows, integrating Agentic AI patterns and SAP s AI services to deliver scalable, intelligent, and automation-ready applications. Own end-to-end implementation, from data and model integration through solution architecture, development, testing, and deployment within SAP landscapes and customer environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, data, and customer teams to drive AI adoption, optimize models in production, and continuously enhance solution quality and impact. Experience with Transforming SAP Business processes with AI & infusing Agentic AI innovations in SAP space. Strategic thinking, client-focused articulation & effective demo/communication experience. Industry & Function Roles: SAP Process AI & Innovations Expert in Supply Chain or FI or Industry Space, Nice to have - Experience with BPM & tools like Signavio Good understanding of SAP standard AI features & setup For functional & industrial roles, a fair understanding of AI technologies and how it influences business processes SAP Certifications preferred - SAP Certified Associate - Positioning SAP Business AI Solutions as part of SAP Business Suite Roles & Responsibilities: - Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery using Generative and Agentic AI to solve complex business problems, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise operations for measurable impact. - Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for SAP BTP and GenAI solutions. - Building technical architecture design aligning with SAP and enterprise standards. - Architect and implement Generative AI pipelines on SAP BTP, leveraging SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud (Vector Engine + Knowledge Graph Engine). - Design and manage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and GraphRAG workflows to improve the grounding, accuracy, and interpretability of LLM outputs. - Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs) with enterprise data sources through grounding modules, vector similarity search, and semantic search. - Build Knowledge Graphs and ontologies to model enterprise domains and link contextual data for reasoning and relationship-aware GenAI applications. - Develop LangChain / LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines for prompt templating, retrieval, generation, and post-processing. - Implement data-masking, content filtering, and schema-based output parsing to ensure compliance, privacy, and structured response formats. - Collaborate with development teams using SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model to embed AI capabilities into cloud-native applications. - Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments. - Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization. - Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision. - Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projects—from model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. - Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope. - Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures. - Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks. - Ensure solution scalability, performance, and responsible AI usage principles are embedded throughout the development lifecycle. - Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives. Professional & Technical Skills: - Deep understanding of SAP BTP services especially AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud (Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engine). - Expertise with Large Language Models, Foundation Models, and LLM Orchestration Frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. - Hands-on experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with embedding, chunking, and vector similarity search. - Proficiency in Knowledge Graph design, GraphRAG, and ontology modelling using SAP HANA Cloud or graph databases. - Strong grasp of data grounding, semantic enrichment, and enterprise contextualization. - Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices & AI evaluation frameworks. - Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments. - Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps. - Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud. - Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions. - Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems. - Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem. - Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem. - Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies. - Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. - Ability to analyze and optimize application performance. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Strong Python and SQL experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, dbt, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications.
